verdict.rationale: Streaming quality is a fair question for a remote-desktop product like TeamViewer, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents adaptive quality under bandwidth constraints or user-adjustable resolution and frame rate. The pricing, homepage and community items cover unrelated features, licensing and security, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a power user, quality adapts when the link falls behind, and I can set resolution and frame rate myself
